name: search_one_precharge

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
p=Path.cwd();plan={'queries':['Wagner degree constrained spanning subgraphs Conjecture 4.2 logarithmic concavity counterexample','valid multisets Z_p^m sumsets Matomaki conjecture','Simmons Su symmetric group Tucker conjecture proof counterexample']}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'plans/search1.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),str(p/'plans/search1.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(z.stdout,z.stderr);assert z.returncode==0
print((p/'sources/wagner.txt').read_text()[18000:28000])
